primary_test_suites.name: paired CPU package isolated unittest suite
existing alert-card and resolution contract tests

supplemental_user_regression_harness.interpretation: The two qualification-gate and mount-overlap cases are exercised through mocked Docker and rejected. Four receipt fault cases are rejected at the new required-field gate before their intended individual corruption is exercised; per the harness note, those outcomes are inconclusive for the intended detailed assertions and are not counted as primary regression proof.

limitations: The task manifest remains BLOCKED_MISSING_VALUES for wall_seconds, memory_bytes, pids_limit, and max_method_output_bytes.
Synthetic tests do not prove real Linux cgroup, network, OOM-kill, host-path, or Docker cleanup behavior.
The full Mac V2 specification and referenced metric/schema files are absent from this checkout.
